request.prompt:
Create one isolated, full-body game-character production prototype for Mass Effect — Armax Relay Clash, using the attached original game reference as the visual authority. Faithfully reproduce the specific original model, its anatomy, proportions, materials, color blocking, equipment placement and asymmetry. Detailed realistic game-render finish, crisp readable silhouette, even studio lighting with subtle material highlights. Output exactly ONE character and ONE view, with the complete head, body, every limb, weapon and feet inside the image and generous transparent padding on all sides. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no ground plane, no cast floor shadow, no scene, no frame, no contact sheet, no text, no captions, no publisher logos. The attached sheet is a reference for the single figure, not a layout to reproduce. Preserve model-side asymmetry; do not mirror the reference. Do not add equipment, insignia, effects or redesigned parts. This is a still pose, not an animation sheet.

Subject: male Shepard wearing the full Inferno Armor from Mass Effect 2, helmet on. Reference 1 is the original full-body EA promotional artwork and controls full-body proportions, leg plates, knee/shin armor and boots. Reference 2 is the Rion game-model sheet and controls helmet, torso, arms, plate shapes and cleaner canonical red/black color blocking. Produce a single relaxed grounded three-quarter standing view facing image-right, both feet clearly visible and hands relaxed at the sides so the armor can be inspected. Preserve the enclosed angular helmet with dark bronze-black face visor, narrow orange lights, deep red rigid plating over a black undersuit, paired round gray shoulder connectors, two small round collar connectors, segmented abdominal plates with black central channel, small orange abdominal lights, circular elbow mechanisms, red forearm/hand plates and the exact leg armor structure seen in reference 1. No bare head, no N7 substitution, no flames, no redesign. Keep the masculine body and original game proportions. Full body from helmet to complete boots on transparent background.
